title: Theo Thinks 7% for 30 Years Is $31K 😂
description:
Theo multiplies 7% by 30 years, gets 210% and announces that his $10,000 will be worth $31,000. Nora does the actual maths: $76,123. In year one he earns $700. In year thirty he earns almost $5,000 at the same 7%, because by then the interest is earning interest too.

Simple interest grows in a straight line. Compound growth snowballs, but only if you leave the money alone for the whole 30 years.

Did you guess $31,000 or $76,000? Tell us below 👇

Follow for more numbers that change how you spend.

⚠️ Illustration with fictional characters: $10,000 at an example 7% a year, compounded yearly, for 30 years, with no fees, taxes, withdrawals or new deposits. 7% is not a forecast; real returns vary and some years are negative. This is not financial advice.
